artist_notes.name: Adam Beyer
artist_notes.note: Swedish techno institution and Drumcode founder — driving, functional, peak-time techno that anchors the darker half of this lineup. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Cloonee
artist_notes.note: Manchester-raised tech-house heavyweight (CLNE, Repopulate Mars, Sola) — Beatport #1s with 'Like What' and a Chris Lake collab ('Nightmares'); reliable festival-circuit crowd-mover. Tracked artist.

artist_notes.name: Loco Dice
artist_notes.note: Tunisian-German DJ born Yassine Ben Achour, Düsseldorf — founder of Desolat; evolved from hip-hop residencies to Space/Hi Ibiza residencies; blends hip-hop textures and North African rhythm into house and tech house.

artist_notes.name: Hi-Lo
artist_notes.note: Oliver Heldens' darker techno alias — HILOMATIK label boss; has dropped on Drumcode and deadmau5's mau5trap; melodic-peak techno pitched between festival and underground.

artist_notes.name: Elderbrook
artist_notes.note: London singer-producer Alexander Kotz — 'Cola' (CamelPhat collab, Grammy-nominated) made him; soulful voice over emotive deep house. Live-electronic act rather than a DJ set.

artist_notes.name: Hayden James
artist_notes.note: Sydney producer — polished, melodic house (multi-Platinum 'Something About You'); RUFUS Du Sol-adjacent but a shade more radio-pop.

artist_notes.name: Sidepiece
artist_notes.note: LA-based duo Party Favor + Nitti Gritti — their 2019 'On My Mind' was Grammy-nominated for Best Dance Recording; peak-time tech house rooted in Motown edits.

artist_notes.name: Westend
artist_notes.note: New York tech house producer Tyler Morris — helped draft the modern American tech-house blueprint; recent single 'The Ceiling' on John Summit's Experts Only.

artist_notes.name: Josh Baker
artist_notes.note: Manchester DJ/producer and You&Me Records founder — groove-heavy, fluid house and minimal; played fabric, DC10, The Warehouse Project.

artist_notes.name: Riordan
artist_notes.note: South-coast UK rising producer — garage-influenced tech house; Beatport #1 'Needle On The Record' on Gorgon City's Realm, plus Black Book and Catch & Release.

artist_notes.name: Greg 99
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer from Minas Gerais — Latin and Afro-inflected tech house; Beatport #1 collab 'Still My Baby' with Cloonee; Insomniac Records debut.

enrichment.curator_note: Day Trip's sixth Long Beach edition at the new Queen Mary Amphitheater is the tech-house festival LA actually needs — the Adam Beyer / Loco Dice / Hi-Lo block gives it real techno weight, and Cloonee headlining keeps it from disappearing up its own prog-house backside. Saturday is the day to go.

artist_notes.note: Ghent-born, one of techno's biggest names — KNTXT label, relentlessly functional hard techno; consistently sells out rooms from Berghain to stadiums. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: DJ Seinfeld
artist_notes.note: Armand Jakobsson — lo-fi deep house producer turned selector, UK Garage and 140 edges on releases for 17 Steps and Lobster Fury. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Luuk van Dijk
artist_notes.note: Dutch house DJ and Filth on Acid co-founder — driving, Rotterdam-flavored tech house and house; one of the harder-working Dutch acts on the festival circuit.

artist_notes.name: Maceo Plex
artist_notes.note: Cuban-American Eric Estornel — Ellum Audio boss; melodic, cosmic techno that bridges Ibiza progressive and warehouse; long-running Dj-Kicks alumnus and Fabric resident.

artist_notes.name: Mau P
artist_notes.note: Dutch DJ/producer Maurits Philipsen — Parisian-style driving tech-house with pop-punk samples; huge Beatport runs ('Drugs From Amsterdam', 'Your Mind Is Fucked'); the mainstream end of the lane. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: Nick León
artist_notes.note: Miami-based producer — club music at the intersection of reggaeton, dembow and experimental electronic; Hyperdub-adjacent and critically acclaimed without the mainstream profile.

artist_notes.name: Tiga
artist_notes.note: Montreal DJ/producer — Turbo Recordings boss, electro-disco-techno crossover ('You Gonna Want Me'); one of the more interesting veteran acts on a lineup this size.

artist_notes.name: Vintage Culture
artist_notes.note: Brazilian producer Luiz Cezar — melodic house and tech-house, massive streaming numbers and festival circuit presence. Tracked.

artist_notes.name: VTSS
artist_notes.note: Warsaw-born, Berlin-based Martyna Maja — fast, industrial EBM-adjacent techno with a fashion-forward aesthetic; Hessle Audio, Codes and her own Novaya imprint.

artist_notes.name: DJ Slugo
artist_notes.note: One of the founding fathers of Chicago ghetto house and juke — 30+ years deep, CEO of Blok Club DJs, and a defining force in the raw 150-165 BPM body-music that predated and shaped footwork. Tracks like 'Where the Rats?' are canonical. A genuine originator, not a tourist.

artist_notes.name: Demuir
artist_notes.note: Canadian DJ/producer (Montreal) and Certified label co-founder — soulful, deep, dancefloor-first house rooted in Chicago and Detroit; records on Defected, Truesoul and his own Certified imprint. The Certified Groovers series is his LA vehicle.

artist_notes.name: Scotty Boy
artist_notes.note: Veteran DJ/producer Scott Schroer — 25+ years in the scene, three Billboard Dance #1s (including 'Shiny Disco Balls', 2014), Sirius XM radio, and Kiss Kiss Bang Bang resident. More polished and radio-house than underground; solid crowd-mover without much edge.
